trans-unit.source: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.
trans-unit.target: Заклинатель открывает вихрь, ведущий в Бездну. Всё, что попадёт в него, будет потеряно навсегда.

trans-unit.source: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.
trans-unit.target: Маг уничтожает врагов изнутри, разъедая их разум сомнениями и кризисом.

trans-unit.source: Master of Blade, Bow and Magic
If it can be casted, shot or slashed with, this one has mastered all he decided to learn.
trans-unit.target: Если этим можно колдовать, стрелять или рубить — этот персонаж освоил всё, что решил изучить.

trans-unit.source: What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?
trans-unit.target: Что за следопыт без стрелы? Кто может быть лучшим без десятков?

trans-unit.source: A ranger should give no reprieve to the foe. Arrows must fall like a deluge, as deadly as lightning.
trans-unit.target: Следопыт не должен давать передышки врагу. Стрелы должны падать как потоп, смертоносные как молния.

trans-unit.source: Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.
trans-unit.target: Пусть каждый болт будет наполнен силой Курноуса и несёт смерть всем его врагам.

trans-unit.source: When the arrow flies farther, it may kill sooner, which is vital in the Hunt.
trans-unit.target: Когда стрела летит дальше, она может убить раньше, что жизненно важно на Охоте.

trans-unit.source: This mage has witnessed and caused death so often, he is tied to the wind of it.
trans-unit.target: Этот маг столь часто был свидетелем и причиной смерти, что связан с её ветром.

trans-unit.source: This mage is a master at shadowplay.
This mage has mastered necromancy completely.
When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.
trans-unit.target: Bu büyü yapıldığında düşman zihinlerini güçsüzleştirir; gerçekliğin ezici ağırlığını üzerlerinde hissederler.

trans-unit.source: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.
trans-unit.target: Büyücü, düşmanları uyuşturan ve aldatan kafa karıştırıcı bir sis örer, tökezleyip sendelemelerine neden olur.

trans-unit.source: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.
trans-unit.target: Büyücü Çukura açılan bir girdap açar. İçine düşen her şey sonsuza dek kaybolur.

trans-unit.source: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.
trans-unit.target: Büyücü düşmanlarını içeriden yok eder, düşman zihinlerini şüphe ve krizle aşındırır.

trans-unit.source: Master of Blade, Bow and Magic
If it can be casted, shot or slashed with, this one has mastered all he decided to learn.
trans-unit.target: Büyülenebilen, atılabilen veya kesilebilen her şeyde, öğrenmeye karar verdiği her şeyi ustaca uygular.

trans-unit.source: What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?
trans-unit.target: Ok olmadan korucu ne işe yarar? Düzinelerce ok olmadan en iyi nasıl olunabilir?

trans-unit.source: A ranger should give no reprieve to the foe. Arrows must fall like a deluge, as deadly as lightning.
trans-unit.target: Bir korucu düşmana soluk aldırmamalıdır. Oklar, şimşek kadar ölümcül bir sel gibi yağmalıdır.

trans-unit.source: Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.
trans-unit.target: Her ok Kurnous'un gücüyle dolu olsun ve tüm düşmanlarına ölüm getirsin.

trans-unit.source: When the arrow flies farther, it may kill sooner, which is vital in the Hunt.
trans-unit.target: Ok daha uzağa uçtuğunda, daha erken öldürebilir, bu da Avda hayati önem taşır.

trans-unit.source: This mage has witnessed and caused death so often, he is tied to the wind of it.
trans-unit.target: Bu büyücü ölümü o kadar çok tanık olmuş ve neden olmuştur ki, onun rüzgarına bağlıdır.

trans-unit.source: This mage is a master at shadowplay.
This mage has mastered necromancy completely.
When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.
trans-unit.target: 施放時，此法術會削弱敵人的意志；他們感到現實的壓迫重量壓在他們身上。

trans-unit.source: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.
trans-unit.target: 施法者編織一團令人困惑的迷霧，使敵人麻木和迷惑，導致他們跌跌撞撞。

trans-unit.source: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.
trans-unit.target: 施法者打開通往深淵的漩渦。任何被困其中的東西都將永遠消失。

trans-unit.source: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.
trans-unit.target: 巫師從內部摧毀敵人，用懷疑和危機腐蝕敵人的心靈。

trans-unit.source: Master of Blade, Bow and Magic
If it can be casted, shot or slashed with, this one has mastered all he decided to learn.
trans-unit.target: 如果可以施法、射擊或劈砍，這位大師已經掌握了他決定學習的一切。

trans-unit.source: What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?
trans-unit.target: 沒有箭的遊俠是什麼？沒有幾十支箭怎能成為最強？

trans-unit.source: A ranger should give no reprieve to the foe. Arrows must fall like a deluge, as deadly as lightning.
trans-unit.target: 遊俠不應給敵人喘息之機。箭矢必須如洪水般落下，如閃電般致命。

trans-unit.source: Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.
trans-unit.target: 讓每支箭都注入庫爾諾斯的力量，給他所有的敵人帶來死亡。

trans-unit.source: When the arrow flies farther, it may kill sooner, which is vital in the Hunt.
trans-unit.target: 當箭矢飛得更遠，它可能更早殺敵，這在狩獵中至關重要。

trans-unit.source: This mage has witnessed and caused death so often, he is tied to the wind of it.
trans-unit.target: 這位法師見證並造成了太多死亡，他與死亡之風緊密相連。

trans-unit.source: This mage is a master at shadowplay.
trans-unit.target: 這位法師是影戲的大師。

trans-unit.source: This mage has mastered necromancy completely.
trans-unit.target: 這位法師完全掌握了亡靈術。
